action_items: Decision required from user/main agent: revert to a working dev-server heap value (>=2048MB start line) OR keep 768 and accept broken preview frontend. Cold-build minimum is 2048MB; recommended 3072MB for margin.
Consider splitting dev vs build heap sizes in package.json scripts (e.g., start=2048, export:web=2048/3072) rather than a single 768 everywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: package.json line 6 (start): NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=768 is insufficient for the Expo/Metro dev server — reproducibly OOMs within ~50s of boot (heap grows to ~762MB against 768MB cap, GC ineffective, exit 134). Constant crash-loop under supervisor.
package.json line 13 (export:web): 768 is well below the empirically measured cold-build minimum of 2048MB. Even 1024 OOMs. Recommend 3072 (383s success with margin) for production builds.

The single unified heap value across dev/build scripts is a design smell — dev-server (long-lived, hot-reload, source watching) and cold export (one-shot, worker-heavy) have very different memory profiles and should be tuned independently.

rca of the issue.issue: Frontend dev-server (yarn start / expo start on port 3000) crash-loops after main agent set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=768 in all 3 script lines of /app/frontend/package.json.
rca of the issue.root_cause: The Expo/Metro dev-server for this SDK54 app (react-native-web + 215 routes + expo-router + reanimated + three.js + recharts + pdfjs) has a working-set well above 768MB. Log shows heap reaching 762MB and GC scavenges becoming ineffective (mu=0.293), triggering V8 OOM fatal (exit 134).
rca of the issue.reproduction: sudo supervisorctl restart frontend; wait ~60s; tail /var/log/supervisor/frontend.err.log -> 'FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit ... JavaScript heap out of memory'. curl http://localhost:3000/ -> connection refused. Supervisor uptime never exceeds ~50s.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Restore start-script heap to >=2048MB (recommend 3072MB). export:web heap must also be >=2048MB (recommend 3072MB) — 1024 also OOMs during cold builds. If tier limit forces 768MB total, the app is not runnable in this environment; push back on memory tier.
